verdict.rationale: Chroma is Apache 2.0 open source and can be run locally or self-hosted at no cost, with a CLI that launches a local server, so developers can prototype without paying. Chroma Cloud also offers $5 of free credits to create a DB and try it out, and a community member called the pricing reasonable with a straightforward calculator. Missing for 10: a documented ongoing Cloud free tier with stated usage limits (only one-time $5 credits are evidenced), detail on how far $5 stretches for prototyping, and independent hands-on corroboration of the free-credit experience.
